recognize_zh: 這是一張正面胸部 X 光片（PA view），不是形態學影像；重點在觀察縱膈輪廓是否增寬以評估 T-ALL/LBL 常見的前縱膈腫塊，本片縱膈上部輪廓略顯突出，但無明顯巨大腫塊或肋膜積液。
features: Superior mediastinal contour mildly prominent without a clearly bulky mass
Lungs clear without consolidation; no pleural effusion
Normal airway midline without obvious tracheal deviation
describe_en: This is a frontal chest radiograph rather than a morphologic image. The superior mediastinal contour appears mildly prominent, but there is no clearly bulky mediastinal mass, tracheal deviation or pleural effusion, and the lungs are clear. In T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma, chest imaging is used to detect an anterior mediastinal (thymic) mass that may cause airway or SVC compromise; this film may represent a baseline or post-treatment study and CT would better define any residual mass.
